description: Phase 2E: simulates the iOS Network Extension's ~50 MiB memory ceiling by running the soak engine subprocess with GOMEMLIMIT=50MiB. Drives the same 1.5C-class channel block (subscription-url-unreachable) and asserts the soak invariant ledger passes unchanged; the engine must continue to behave correctly under the GOMEMLIMIT constraint. The bridge fires a `memory_pressure_warning` lifecycle event mid-run; the engine must record it in diagnostics without bumping the session epoch or otherwise mutating engine state.
